notes: 26.5% of the frame is unclaimed and it is the MID-GROUND BAND that matters: the pack-deer left of the scholar got no plane, nor did the earth ledge to the right of him, nor the two servant figures at bottom right, nor the rocks at centre-right. Add planes for those and keep the ones that already cut well (pine, bridge, cliff, river). The deer stands on the same ground as the scholar and must share his depth, not the river's.
note: x,y normalised 0..1. depth 0 = farthest. window in native px; a mask cannot exceed it.
